description.to:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** Settled: new-story replaces alert lists; subscribers move without re-confirming. Roundups stay in the plugin until the digest epic. As an existing subscriber, nothing changes for me but the machinery, and my old links still work.

**Build.**
- One-off job per site, using both tables in the same account: profiles, `LIST#` rows of alert lists only, `SUPP#` rows; writes subscription and consent rows, with consent evidence copied and marked `migrated`. Idempotent; dry run first. The SES account suppression list is already shared, so no import.
- Unsubscribe and preferences routes keep working and forward alert-list changes, since manage tokens in sent mail never expire. `announce_published` stops raising alert issues once a site has moved. Panel stops listing alert issues there. `docs/newsletter.md` updated. Sites with alert lists today: Shipped and Distinctive.

**Acceptance.**
Counts match per list; a migrated site sends one message per publish, not two; an old link unsubscribes; a suppressed address stays suppressed.

**Depends on:** PPY-38be08
**Related:** kanbus-b47fad

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Migration
  Scenario: Moved without re-confirming
    Given a confirmed subscriber on an alert list
    When the migration runs
    Then they are subscribed with their original consent evidence
    And they receive no confirmation mail

  Scenario: An old unsubscribe link
    Given a subscriber migrated
    When they use the unsubscribe link in an old email
    Then they are unsubscribed in the new system
```
